boxes.title: Act of 1858: more
items: Title: ==**Act for the Good Government of India**==
Territories and **revenues** of India to the Crown
Also the answer in **UPPSC 2010**; distractors: Charter Acts 1833/1853, **Pitt's Act**, ICA 1861
1833 Charter Act: Company made ==purely administrative==
SoS could **issue orders to the Viceroy**; Council **advised** the SoS

boxes.title: Proclamation: more
items: Reading at Allahabad: **UPPSC 2009**
Company **treaties honoured**; princes' rights, dignity, honour respected
Ancient **rights, usages, customs** respected; property and succession protected
Peasants' land rights ==while revenue was paid==
Opening of the concluding line: "The well-being of our Indian subjects is our strength"
SoS ==**Kimberley**==: enough civil servants "shall always be Europeans"
⚠ Some notes put the Empress title at the Allahabad Durbar of 1858

boxes.title: Princes & army: more
items: Territorial integrity guaranteed if princes accepted ==**Crown as ultimate sovereign**==
Princes became **subordinate allies**, props of British rule
Before: three presidency armies (**Bengal, Madras, Bombay**)
Madras/Bombay ratio ⚠ other notes: **1:3**
Indians barred from **heavy weapons**; key positions to Europeans
Martial races from **Punjab**, **NWFP**, not **Awadh and Bihar**

boxes.title: Policy shifts: more
head: Factor
Added detail
rows: ==First **anti-Muslim policies**==; later Muslims cultivated vs educated Hindu middle class
Annexation of large estates reversed; **proprietary rights** → loyalist class (Awadh)

boxes.title: AP & today
items: Coastal Andhra, Rayalaseema stayed in ==**Madras Presidency**==; Telangana under the Nizam
Madras Native Association: ==first to petition== on non-implementation
**Gandhi** called the Proclamation a "Magna Carta" (12 May 2026)
